svg.title: 03 | Components - Board Web App
svg.desc: Expands: Board Web App (02-containers). All blue boxes are in-process TypeScript modules, not deployed services.

text.tspan: Expands: Board Web App (02-containers). All blue boxes are in-process TypeScript modules, not deployed services.
BOARD WEB APP [Container: Node.js + TypeScript + Express]
Owns transactions, workshop locks and persistence.
Workshop and Reservation rows; locks and constraints.
HTTPS / JSON: recipient, title/time, reservation ID
Unique workshop ID; nonblank trimmed title; valid timestamp; integer capacity 1-20.
Store ownership; publish checks stored owner ID atomically.
No edit/unpublish/cancel feature or capacity changes are in scope.
Legend: blue = in-process component; green = supporting person/data store; grey = external system; dashed outline = parent container.
All component-to-component arrows are typed function calls; labels show inputs and results. wid = workshop ID; Contact = name + email.
